mardiehl/stdlib_os.manifest:
name = "stdlib-os"
version = "0.0.0"
license = "MIT"
[library]
source-dir = "playground-library"
include-dir = ["src", "."]
[build]
auto-executables = false
auto-examples = false
auto-tests = false
[install]
library = true
[fortran]
implicit-typing = true
implicit-external = true
source-form = "default"

edits.after: use, intrinsic :: ISO_C_Binding, only: C_CHAR, C_NULL_CHAR, C_INT, C_INT64_T, C_DOUBLE

scope: Mixed C/Fortran operating-system utilities wrapped for FPM. Two checksum-guarded compatibility edits set the Linux os_name constant and restrict the ISO_C_BINDING import to avoid the Fortran 2023 F_C_STRING name collision. OS_SYSTEM_ID is configured as OS_LINUX. The checked consumer creates nested temporary directories and a 14-byte stream file, checks file size and type, basename/dirname and path normalization, then renames and deletes the file and removes both directories. No external files or user environment are required. This configured recipe and exported project target Linux; Windows branches, processes, user/home lookup and every path utility are not validated.
